app.name: CookCompass
app.tagline: Learn to cook with what your local shops sell.
footer.local: Runs entirely on your computer. No tracking.
flash.deleted: Moved to trash. You can restore it any time.
flash.scanned: Scan finished. New items are waiting in the review queue.
flash.goal_saved: Goal saved. Here is your plan.
flash.location_failed: We couldn't detect your location. Please pick it below.
validation.invalid_choice: Please pick one of the options.
validation.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
validation.url: Please enter a full web address (https://…).
validation.youtube_only: Only YouTube links can be embedded.
validation.duplicate: An item with this code already exists.
validation.bad_form: The form could not be read. Please try again.
validation.shop_template_placeholder: The template must contain {q} where the search term goes.
admin.title: Admin
admin.shop_template_hint: Must contain {q}, which is replaced with the ingredient name — e.g. https://shop.example/search?q={q}. CookCompass never fetches this URL; it only builds links for you to click.
admin.product_url_hint: Direct link to this product in the shop; used for exact buy links.
admin.confirm_delete: Move this recipe to the trash?
admin.field_ingredients_help: One ingredient per line, e.g. "2 cups flour, sifted". Add "(optional)" for ingredients the dish works without.
admin.field_steps_help: One step per line. Write for someone cooking for the first time.
admin.user_wins: Edits made here are kept even if the recipe is scraped again.
home.hero_title: Learn to cook, one easy win at a time.
home.start_here_hint: Quick, easy dishes that build the basics.
browse.title: Recipes
browse.only_cookable: Only what I can cook now
browse.country_note: showing what you can buy where you live
browse.empty: No recipes match. Try removing a filter.
browse.pantry_hint: Tell us what you have at home to use this filter.
flash.recipes_imported: Dataset imported: new recipes are in the queue.
flash.import_nothing_new: Nothing new: every recipe in that dataset is already known (or was invalid). See the server log for counts.
list.title: Shopping list
list.empty: The list is empty. Add a recipe's ingredients from its page, or the whole meal plan from Goals.
flash.need_goal: Fill in your goal first — then the plan can become a shopping list.
admin.translate_overwrite_confirm: Replace the existing {{.Locale}} translation with a machine draft? The current text stays in the revision history.
flash.translated: Machine draft saved and flagged for review.
flash.translate_failed: Translation failed — is the translator configured and reachable?
admin.cache_image_hint: Downloads the image and serves it from this server (/media), so pages stop hotlinking the source site.
admin.storage_disabled: Image storage is not configured (empty COOK_S3_ENDPOINT) or unreachable; images keep their original URLs.
flash.media_failed: Storing the image failed — see the server log.
admin.import_recipes_help: A JSON array, JSONL stream or nested dump of schema.org Recipe objects (e.g. the OpenRecipes export). Drop big files into data/recipe-inbox/ and pick them here, or point at a URL (≤5 MB). Recipes without steps or ingredients are rejected automatically.
admin.import_dataset_approve_hint: Off by default: new recipes wait in the queue for review, like scraped ones.
recipe.watch_video: Watch a video of this dish

availability.recipe_unavailable.one: {{.Count}} ingredient isn't sold where you live, and there is no local substitute.
availability.recipe_unavailable.other: {{.Count}} ingredients aren't sold where you live, and there are no local substitutes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.where_hint: We only suggest recipes you can buy ingredients for in your country.
settings.shop_hint: Buy links on recipes point to this shop's search when no exact product page is known.
settings.strict_shop: Only count products sold in my shop
settings.strict_shop_hint: Availability is checked against your shop plus country-wide products, not every shop.
settings.show_unavailable: Show recipes I can't buy ingredients for
settings.show_unavailable_hint: Off by default so you only see what you can actually cook.
settings.prefs_hint: Recipes with your allergens are never shown. Disliked ingredients are hidden unless you turn that filter off.
settings.pantry_hint: Tick what you have at home. Salt, pepper, oil and water are assumed.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.bad_register: Please choose a username (3+ characters) and a password (8+ characters).
error.not_found_body: We couldn't find that page or recipe. It may have been removed.
error.server_body: Sorry — that didn't work. Please try again; if it keeps happening, check the server logs.
home.goal_cta_body: Tell us a little about yourself and your goal. We'll pick 3–5 real recipes for today that fit your calories and macros.
goals.title: Goals & daily plan
goals.intro: Your targets are estimated with the Mifflin–St Jeor equation and your activity level, then adjusted for your goal.
goals.disclaimer: Estimates for healthy adults, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor if you are pregnant, have a medical condition, or plan a big change.
goals.targets_explain: Resting burn (BMR) ≈ {{.BMR}} kcal; with activity ≈ {{.TDEE}} kcal per day.
goals.fill_form: Fill in the form to see your targets and a plan for today.
activity.active: Very active (hard exercise 6–7 days a week)
activity.very_active: Extremely active (physical job or training twice a day)
goal.lose_weight_desc: about 500 kcal below your daily burn, more protein to keep muscle
goal.gain_muscle_desc: a small surplus and plenty of protein
goal.gain_weight_desc: about 500 kcal above your daily burn
goal.eat_healthier_desc: same energy, balanced macros and more fiber
plan.title: What to eat today
plan.closest: Closest match from the recipes available to you
plan.empty: Not enough recipes are available to build a plan. Try showing unavailable recipes or removing some dislikes.
admin.confirm_purge: Delete every pending item? Approved and rejected items are kept.
admin.queue_hint: Scraped and imported items wait here until you approve them. Open a recipe to fix its details before approving.
flash.scrape_failed: Nothing could be fetched (offline, or every page was blocked). Existing recipes are unchanged.
admin.import_help: CSV columns: sku, name, category, ingredient, price, unit (only name is required). JSON follows docs/schemas/catalog.schema.json. Rows with a known SKU (or the same name) update the existing product; imported rows count as your own edits.
admin.product_user_wins: Edits made here are kept when catalogs are scanned again.
flash.import_failed: Import failed. Check the file format (CSV or JSON) and the server log for the rows that were rejected.
settings.locate_nojs: Location detection needs JavaScript; pick your country below.
settings.rescan_hint: Checks shop catalogs for new products. New items appear after review.
learn.title: Learning path
learn.intro: Cook your way up: learn 5 easy recipes, then 5 medium, then 5 hard. Mark a recipe as learned when you can make it without stress.
learn.unlock_hint: finish the previous level to unlock
learn.next_hint: Recipes at your current level that you can cook where you live.
learn.no_next: No more recipes at this level are available to you right now. Try showing unavailable recipes in Settings.
learn.no_history: Nothing yet — press "I cooked this" on a recipe after you make it.
learn.all_done: You've completed the whole path. Impressive!
recipe.learned_hint: Learned = you could cook it again without the steps open.
recipe.login_to_track: log in to track what you cook.
admin.pending_summary: {{.Recipes}} recipes and {{.Products}} products are waiting for review.
flash.scrape_started: Import started in the background. Refresh this page in a minute — new recipes appear in the queue below.
